paper: P. M. Preiss et al., High-Contrast Interference of Ultracold Fermions, Phys. Rev. Lett. 122, 143602 (2019)

digitized_intensity_csv.layout: Headerless matrix in raster order. Columns are q1 from left to right (-3.7 to +3.7). Rows are q2 from top to bottom (+3.7 to -3.7). Both axes use pixel centers inside these bounds, in units of k/k_lat. Values are recovered colorbar intensities before normalizing over the displayed window.
